accepted_behavior_that_failed: Twenty V5 units were labelled QUALITY_GAP and retained EXPAND/SECTION actions, while many gap_evidence values only said that the selected action requires fuller same-task coverage.
why_previous_qa_passed: The third-audit verifier checked gap fields for presence, allowed values, action/gap consistency and downstream accounting; those checks all passed.
why_it_is_wrong: A selected EXPAND/SECTION action cannot independently prove that current content is thin/incomplete. QUALITY_GAP requires a fresh current-page read and explicit missing user needs. Several earlier fresh rechecks already changed old EXPAND/QUALITY_GAP conclusions to NONE/KEEP, proving the failure is material.
root_cause: Schema completeness and action consistency were mistaken for causal evidence validation; the generator's action logic also generated the explanation that the verifier then accepted.
corrective_action: Freshly re-read every one of the 20 current QUALITY_GAP units; materialize current-page coverage, member user needs, needs already covered, explicit missing needs and materiality; derive STRUCTURAL_GAP_STATE and CONTENT_ENHANCEMENT_STATE before action; change actions where current content disproves the old gap.
verification_required: 20/20 units have fresh current-page evidence; QUALITY_GAP without explicit missing need = 0; QUALITY_GAP without current page read = 0; action-derived-only gap evidence = 0; EXPAND/SECTION without independently proven current-content deficit = 0; an independent verifier recomputes diagnosis without using final action as causal input.
notes: Raised by post-PASS external method audit. Previous 27/27 defect closure remains historical evidence but no longer proves Step12 complete.

accepted_behavior_that_failed: Twenty-eight V5 internal-link rows were marked IMPLEMENT from Step12 routing relationships, with source/target URLs and generic contextual implementation text, but without a fresh proof that the current source page contains a suitable link context and the target page actually serves the stated next user task.
why_previous_qa_passed: The D12-26 verifier checked material-link coverage, URL presence, duplicates, withdrawn proposed-new targets and explicit NA/defer states. It did not independently read current source and target content for every IMPLEMENT row.
why_it_is_wrong: A routing edge is an architectural hypothesis, not proof of a useful contextual link. An IMPLEMENT instruction can point users to a target that does not actually answer the stated task or can assume a source context that is not present.
root_cause: Graph relationship evidence was promoted directly into implementation truth; representation coverage was mistaken for current source-context and target-fit evidence.
corrective_action: Freshly re-read source and target pages for all 28 prior IMPLEMENT rows; preserve source context, target task-fit evidence and user-next-step helpfulness; retain IMPLEMENT only when all three are proven, otherwise use explicit DEFER/NOT_APPLICABLE states.
verification_required: 28/28 prior IMPLEMENT rows revalidated; IMPLEMENT without current source context = 0; IMPLEMENT without current target fit = 0; IMPLEMENT without user-helpfulness justification = 0; independent verifier can reject as well as accept a proposed link; downstream link/action/pair artifacts rebuilt if routes change.
notes: Raised by post-PASS external method audit after comparing V5 link generation against current Ahrefs/Yandex internal-link guidance.
